summary: Bullish (NYSE: BLSH) filed a Form 6-K furnished with a press release announcing its plan to release Q1 2026 financial results on May 14, 2026, with an earnings conference call. The release also discloses fully diluted outstanding share counts computed using an average Q1 price of $35.07 and the March 31 close of $35.73. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. No event—acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change—is described. The filing is a standard quarterly financial reporting update.
